one_liner: Gumroad has a free, self-serve REST v2 API with OAuth2 and non-expiring access tokens, plus a vendor-run MCP server, so a toolkit can ship now.
auth_notes: Create an application under Settings > Advanced. For multi-user use, build a Redirect URI handler for OAuth authorization-code flow. For your own account, generate a non-expiring access token manually. Composio lists OAUTH2 as managed. The scope list in the draft is not verified from the supplied pages.
access_notes: Any account can create an application and generate an access token (per the README of a community MCP server; the claim of no billing gate is from a third-party guide, not Gumroad's own docs).
blocker_notes: No blocker found. Third-party users must authorize via OAuth. No documented sandbox.

evidence.quote: Gumroad runs a server that speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol)
The connector is run by Gumroad.
Every assistant connects to its own URL and asks for OAuth access to your Gumroad account.
Use the "Generate access token" button to get your access token.
